_schema_note: BRP (Basic Roleplaying, Chaosium, ORC License) sheet, characteristics on the 3-18 scale. HP = (CON+SIZ)/2 rounded up. SAN starts at POW x 5; san.max = 99 - forbidden_lore (this world's own skill, see rules/sanity_rules.md). san.beat_turn / san.beat_start / san.beat_loss track losses within one beat (one GM turn) for temporary insanity (beat_loss >= beat_start/2). Total SAN lost = san.starting - san.current (used by event min_san_loss). damage_bonus from STR+SIZ (24 -> none). afflictions[] holds lingering marks: {name, subject, gained_at_tick}.
